title: Anthropic and OpenAI to Highlight Key AI Trends at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will feature an AI-focused stage with leaders from Anthropic, OpenAI, Databricks, Okta, AWS, and other companies. The event will explore critical topics such as enterprise AI deployment, AI-native go-to-market strategies, security challenges in agentic AI, evolving SaaS business models, and the emergence of new job categories like GTM engineering. Sessions will provide insights into real-world AI applications, pricing models, and infrastructure-level security requirements for enterprises.
key_points: Anthropic’s Head of Applied AI, Cat de Jong, will discuss real-world enterprise deployments of Claude, including success patterns and challenges.
OpenAI’s Head of Productivity, Tara Seshan, will explore the rise of AI-native go-to-market (GTM) strategies and the new discipline of GTM engineering.
Sessions will address critical AI security issues, including infrastructure-level requirements for agentic AI and enterprise observability.
Panel discussions will analyze how AI is reshaping SaaS business models, pricing strategies, and defensibility in a commoditized model landscape.
The event will highlight emerging job categories like GTM engineering, which has grown rapidly due to AI-driven changes in tech.
Leaders from Databricks, Okta, AWS, and other companies will share insights on AI security, scalability, and enterprise adoption.
TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will take place October 13–15 in San Francisco, featuring networking opportunities and access to startup-focused content.
